transforms.name: cumulative-sample
transforms.effect: Live non-duplicate samples carry cumulativeTokens. Bootstrap samples are not usage upserts.

transforms.name: reduce-copy
transforms.effect: The reducer copies cumulativeTokens. Pricing may add costUsd and does not erase the counter.

transforms.name: row-tokens
transforms.effect: derive maps cumulativeTokens to tokens.total and burnRatePerMin to tokens.perMinute when the index produces a rate.
